headline: SpaceX discloses a $1.25B monthly Anthropic compute agreement with a 90-day exit right
summary: SpaceX's May 20, 2026 SEC Form S-1 says it entered cloud-services agreements with Anthropic for compute access across Colossus and Colossus II. SpaceX states that Anthropic agreed to pay $1.25 billion per month through May 2029 after discounted ramp-up fees in May and June 2026, while either party may terminate on 90 days' notice. A June 1 SEC response repeats the stated monthly amount and says SpaceX did not view the contracts as a substantial dependence because capacity and revenue could be redeployed. The filing establishes the issuer's disclosed contract terms, not realized payments, delivered capacity, utilization or a guaranteed three-year spend.
